name: 909 acid shuffle
desc: Shuffled sibling of the acid ride: triplet-feel ride and hats via elongation ([rd@2 rd]*4), rim-tinted claps, and a rotating tom figure that walks around the bar with iter. Swings where .01 drives straight; darker and more hypnotic.

pump.doc: ride duck floor as fraction of gain

code.full: stack(s("bd*4").gain(${gain}).shape(.2), s("~ cp ~ [cp rim]").gain(${gain}*.62).room(.2).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)), s("[rd@2 rd]*4").gain(saw.range(${gain}*${pump}, ${gain}*.52).fast(4)).lpf(cosine.range(${bright}*.5, ${bright}).slow(16)), s("~ ~ [~ lt] ~ ~ [mt ~] ~ ~").iter(4).gain(${gain}*.45).pan(sine.range(.3, .7).slow(12))).bank("RolandTR909").orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd*4").gain(${gain}).shape(.25), s("~ cp ~ [cp rim]").gain(${gain}*.65).room(.2).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)), s("[rd@2 rd]*4").ply("<1 1 2>").gain(saw.range(${gain}*${pump}, ${gain}*.55).fast(4)).lpf(cosine.range(${bright}*.55, ${bright}).slow(8)), s("[~ oh]*4").gain(${gain}*.48).lpf(${bright}), s("~ ~ [~ lt] ~ [ht ~] [mt ~] ~ [~ mt]").iter(8).gain(${gain}*.5).pan(sine.range(.25, .75).slow(8))).bank("RolandTR909").orbit(1).play()
